observations.posthog_connection: Checks for potential API pagination truncation in Zuora commerce endpoints; if the response fills the requested page, the connector fails rather than silently accepting a potentially incomplete dataset.

observations.behavior: Adds _commerce_endpoint and _object_query_endpoint functions; _commerce_endpoint selects either a cursor-based paginator or the new full-page guard, while _object_query_endpoint retains cursor pagination and incremental filtering.
observations.posthog_connection: Routes commerce-specific Zuora endpoints through a paginator that guards against full-page truncation, while keeping object-query endpoints on cursor pagination.

observations.behavior: Removes the inline params and paginator setup from zuora_source, replacing them with a call to _commerce_endpoint or _object_query_endpoint depending on the endpoint type.
observations.posthog_connection: Centralizes endpoint configuration and paginator selection, removing duplicated inline setup and enabling consistent behavior across commerce and object-query endpoints.
